onboarding.title: Welcome to Tamp 👋
onboarding.lead: Shrink screen recordings to a size you can share — in four steps.
onboarding.step1Detail: Tamp sits in your tray, near the clock. On Windows it hides under the ^ overflow arrow. Press {shortcut} to show or hide this panel anytime.
onboarding.step2Detail: In Preferences, create one for where you share — say "Discord", capped at 10 MB. (Discord (10 MB) comes built in.)
onboarding.step3Detail: Drop a video here, right-click one in Explorer → "Compress with Tamp", or press {shortcut} to shrink your latest.
onboarding.step4Detail: The smaller file is copied to your clipboard — just paste it wherever you're sharing.
onboarding.updatePrivacyHint: Only asks GitHub for the latest version — nothing about you is sent.

update.body: A newer version of Tamp is ready. Update whenever it suits you — this won't change anything until you choose to.
